fields.notes:
Disciple of Bhūgarbha Gosvāmī, living in Vṛndāvana; one of those who told Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja to write the Caitanya-caritāmṛta («Kumudānanda Cakravartī, Premī Kṛṣṇadāsa», Ādi 8.69). According to the Sādhana-dīpikā (1) Rūpa Gosvāmī first gave him the service of Govinda, and he handed it on to Haridāsa Paṇḍita (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, «Kṛṣṇadāsa (Premī)»). The record had «Rūpa Gosvāmī (dīkṣā)» as guru and Haridāsa Paṇḍita as disciple: Rūpa gave him the service, not dīkṣā, and Haridāsa received the service from him.

The record «Premī Kṛṣṇadāsa» #1116 (disciple of Bhūgarbha Gosvāmī, Nāmāmṛta-samudra 160) was the same person and was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

fields.aka: Kānu Ṭhākura, Kānāi Ṭhākura, Śiśu Kṛṣṇadāsa, Kānudāsa
fields.notes:
Son of Puruṣottama dāsa Ṭhākura and Jāhnavā, grandson of Sadāśiva Kavirāja (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.39-40). His mother died after his birth; Nityānanda named him Śiśu Kṛṣṇadāsa and Jāhnavā Mātā brought him up at Khaḍadaha and took him to Vṛndāvana, where Jīva Gosvāmī called him Kānāi Ṭhākura. His anklet fell at Bodhkhānā. Descendants at Bodhkhānā and Bhājanghāṭ; disciple Śrīrāma. Songs signed Kānudāsa / Kānurāma dāsa (Padakalpataru).

The record «Sisu Kṛṣṇa Dāsa» #1415 («a disciple of Nityānanda Prabhu, known as Kānu Ṭhākura») was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

fields.aka: Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Mahārāja, Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura Prabhupāda, Bimala Prasāda Datta, Siddhānta Sarasvatī
fields.notes:
Bimala Prasāda, son of Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura and Bhāgavatī Devī, born in Purī in 1874. Title Siddhānta Sarasvatī for his astronomy. Dīkṣā from Gaura Kiśora dāsa Bābājī at Godruma (1900); chanted a billion names at Māyāpura from 1905; defeated the smārtas at Midnapore (1911). Took tridaṇḍa-sannyāsa himself before his guru's picture at Māyāpura (1918). Founded the Gauḍīya Maṭha: sixty-four maṭhas in India, Rangoon and London; sent sannyāsīs to Europe (1933). Left the world on 1 January 1937 in Calcutta.

The record «Siddantha Sarawati» #1405, which held only the list of his books, was joined to this one (07-11-2026).
